Name: Starblue Valley Unofficial Dumpster Texture Fix
Author: ElChingles
Description:
[size=3]This mod fixes a bug in the train station dumpster textures when the[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869] Starblue Valley mod[/url][size=3]﻿ (by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51485186]strangelyliteral[/url][size=3]) is installed.[/size]
[size=3]I love [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley mod[/url][size=3], that's why I've been fixing some things little by little for my personal use, like a [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14302]Spanish translation[/url][size=3] of it.[/size]
[size=3]I wasn't going to share this without the author's permission, but since it's been inactive for a long time, here it is.[/size]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]To install it: [/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]If you don't have the [/size][b][color=#a4c2f4]Starblue Valley mod[/color][/b][size=3] installed ([/size][i][size=2]I don't know what you're doing here[/size][/i][size=3]) first download it from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]its official nexus page[/url], then extract it into the mods folder in the game directory. Then just download this fix. Extract it to the mods folder. It will ask you to overwrite 4 files. Accept. Enjoy the game.[/size]
